description:
A New Standard for Image Viewers

BandiView is the succeeding image viewer to Honeyview, that inherits everything cool of its predecessor and also gets improved even further. Fast and easy to view images in a variety of formats, from the most common ones to the most professional ones.
- Added support for Adobe HDR JPEG files
- Added an option to apply adaptive HDR tone mapping
- Improved HDR image display to reflect Windows 11 HDR calibration settings
- Improved the loading speed for DNG files
- Improved the loading speed for images in archives
- Improved the display of EXIF and XMP metadata
- Fixed a bug that the program cannot display some Ultra HDR HEIC files
- Fixed a bug that white areas appear along the right and bottom edges of some DNG images
- Fixed a bug that the keyboard cannot scroll to the bottom in Webtoon view mode
- Fixed a bug that files with long paths cannot be deleted
- Fixed a bug that opening a file on a NAS may open a different file
- Fixed a vulnerability that occurs when uninstalling the program (KVE-2026-2462)
- Fixed a vulnerability that occurs with XMP metadata (KVE-2026-2465)
- Improved program stability
- Other modifications
